title: Subject Teacher
format: Actual application screen captures with fictional isolated demo records; no live authentication, native installation or reconnect sync verification
voice: User-selected English voice-02; not a verified Nigerian-English accent

scenes.label: School link & sign-in
scenes.narration: Open your school's branded link. Staff and parents use their registered phone and four-digit PIN. This recording uses fictional demo records and a local session, not live authentication.

scenes.label: Assigned subject → score entry
scenes.narration: Choose Results and Report Cards. Check the session, term, class and subject before entering scores. We change one fictional learner score here; your real account remains limited to its assignments.

scenes.label: Combined teaching group
scenes.narration: Use Recording Mode to select your assigned combined group. Learners retain their home classes, so scores entered once can feed their class results. Inspect the actual A four marksheet preview.

scenes.label: Exam paper drafting & submission
scenes.narration: Choose Exam Questions and open the demo draft. Review the question and its options before submission. The Exam Officer handles approval; a subject teacher does not gain all-school reporting permissions.

scenes.label: Install school app
scenes.narration: Open your school's link and choose Install school app. The real help dialog explains Safari and Chrome steps. A native installation is not being verified here.

scenes.label: Offline scores & reconnect
scenes.narration: Sign in online and open needed records before offline work. Attendance and score drafts can sync when reconnected; review conflicts. Payments, messages and new sign-ins need internet. This demo does not verify live sync. Keep any unsynced work on your own device.
